args.title: Fix CSV export to handle different currencies
args.body: Issue 4206 reports a bug in `src/export/csv.ts` where transactions that have the same date, amount, and description but differ in currency (for example, one in EUR and another in USD) are merged improperly in the exported CSV. This means that only one of those transactions appears in the output, which is critical for accurate financial reporting. The proposed change will ensure that such transactions are treated as separate entities in the CSV export, allowing both to be displayed.
